findings.rationale: Reproduced: min(total, 2^31-1) scored reward 1 on the returned bytes, because the largest sealed total was 1,949,204,504. Rule 3.2 (the total is the sum) is core, so it is backed rather than dropped. solution/jobgen.py limits() now adds a second sealed file (DM3-0014) of 200 containers, alternating DRY/REEFER, discharge days 0/3,650, 121-day stays at 100,000 cents: total 4,600,000,000, past 2^31 and 2^32. test_rule_1_2_limits_reached also asserts that some sealed total exceeds 2^32. The other 8 sealed files are byte-identical. Class swept (fixed-width total): clamp at 2^31-1 and 2^32-1, and a signed and an unsigned 32-bit wrap. All survived or were only incidentally caught on the returned bytes, and all are rejected on the limits witness now. Per-line charges (max 23,200,000) and the most negative total (-80,000,000) cannot reach 32 bits, so the class has no other member. instruction.md, environment/, solution/solve.sh, fix.patch and model.py are byte-identical.
